1. **[Air Quality Operating Permit AQ-2024-0117 §5.1]** Notify the Department by telephone within 24 hours of any malfunction that causes emissions to exceed a limit in Section 1, and in writing within 7 days. — **Record:** Notification log and written report.
2. **[Air Quality Operating Permit AQ-2024-0117 §4.1]** Submit an annual emissions inventory report to the Department by March 1 of each year, covering the previous calendar year. — **Record:** Annual emissions inventory report.
3. **[Air Quality Operating Permit AQ-2024-0117 §4.2]** Submit a semi-annual monitoring report by July 31 and January 31, summarizing all deviations from permit conditions. — **Record:** Semi-annual monitoring report.
